SRC-GS1-GPC.title: GS1 Global Product Classification (GPC)
SRC-GS1-GPC.researched: Four-tier hierarchy Segment > Family > Class > Brick; bricks group products by purpose/form/material and carry brick attributes (attribute types + values). One brick per trade item.
informed: level model (Main Category > Subcategory > Sub-subcategory > Product type ≈ Segment > Family > Class > Brick)
attribute-on-leaf model
externalRefs.gpcBrick field

SRC-UNSPSC.title: UNSPSC (United Nations Standard Products and Services Code)
SRC-UNSPSC.researched: 8-digit Segment/Family/Class/Commodity (2 digits each) + optional 2-digit business function; UNDP has managed change requests and releases since 1 Jan 2025 (GS1 US until end-2024); UNv26.0801 lists 158,448 items. Covers products AND services in one code set.
informed: single tree for products + services (type = product | service | both)
externalRefs.unspsc field
Chemicals & Laboratory category (UNSPSC has dedicated chemical and laboratory/measuring segments)

SRC-UN-CPC.title: UN Central Product Classification CPC Ver. 2.1
SRC-UN-CPC.researched: Classifies goods AND services; CPC 2.1 is the latest version with complete published materials (CPC 3.0 forthcoming); correspondence tables to HS 2012/2017 and ISIC Rev.4. Service sections 5–9 (e.g. div. 63 accommodation & food serving, 64–68 transport/postal/courier, 71 financial, 82–83 legal/accounting/professional, 85 support services, 87 maintenance & repair, 92 education, 93 health & social, 96 recreation/culture/sport, 97 other services incl. laundry & personal care).
informed: service-domain subcategories for CAT-16..CAT-26
externalRefs.cpc field (division level)

SRC-ISIC.title: ISIC Rev.4 (International Standard Industrial Classification)
SRC-ISIC.researched: Industry (activity) classification with sections A–U (A agriculture/forestry/fishing, B mining, C manufacturing, F construction, G trade, H transport, I accommodation & food, J information & communication, K finance, L real estate, M professional, N administrative support, P education, Q health, R arts/entertainment, S other services).
informed: Sector (level 0) grouping and isicSections tags on sectors

SRC-GOOGLE-PT.title: Google Merchant Center product taxonomy
SRC-GOOGLE-PT.researched: 21 top-level categories (Animals & Pet Supplies, Apparel & Accessories, Arts & Entertainment, Baby & Toddler, Business & Industrial, Cameras & Optics, Electronics, Food Beverages & Tobacco, Furniture, Hardware, Health & Beauty, Home & Garden, Luggage & Bags, Mature, Media, Office Supplies, Religious & Ceremonial, Software, Sporting Goods, Toys & Games, Vehicles & Parts); 5,595 categories in the 2021-09-21 file; up to 7 levels; numeric IDs reused across languages.
informed: gap detection (Media/Books, Sporting Goods, Toys & Games, Luggage & Bags, Religious & Ceremonial, Jewelry & Watches)
numeric/stable-ID policy
externalRefs.googleCategoryId field

SRC-JUMIA.title: Jumia Kenya storefront (African marketplace reference)
SRC-JUMIA.researched: Retail navigation centred on Phones & Tablets, Computing, Fashion (women/men), Beauty, Home appliances.
informed: buyer-facing ordering of sectors and displayName style

SRC-TZ-TMDA-TBS.title: Tanzania — TMDA and TBS product regulation
SRC-TZ-TMDA-TBS.researched: TMDA regulates medicines, medical devices and diagnostics; regulation of cosmetics and food moved to TBS (2019 Finance Act change). TBS also runs product standards / import conformity.
informed: regulatory flags REG-TMDA (CAT-19 medicines/devices, CAT-04/31 vet medicines) and REG-TBS (food, cosmetics, building materials)

SRC-TZ-TCRA.title: TCRA — type approval of electronic communication equipment
SRC-TZ-TCRA.researched: Telecommunication/radio-communication equipment requires TCRA type approval before sale/use in Tanzania.
informed: regulatory flag REG-TCRA on CAT-12 and radio/networking leaves

SRC-TZ-TPHPA.title: TPHPA — pesticide control
SRC-TZ-TPHPA.researched: On 22 Jan 2026 TPHPA withdrew 805 pesticide products (e.g. paraquat, dimethoate, acephate) and banned their import; earlier removals of 245 and bans of 44 highly hazardous pesticides.
informed: REG-TPHPA flag + mandatory registrationNumber attribute on crop-protection leaves
moderation rule: block listing of withdrawn products

SRC-TZ-TFRA.title: TFRA — fertilizer regulation (Fertilizers Act 2009)
SRC-TZ-TFRA.researched: Fertilizers and fertilizer dealers must be registered under the Fertilizers Act 2009 administered by TFRA; agricultural inputs (seeds, pesticides, fertilizer) each have registration/certification routes.
informed: REG-TFRA flag on CAT-02 Mbolea

SRC-TZ-MINING.title: Tanzania Mining Commission — mineral trading licences
SRC-TZ-MINING.researched: Trading minerals (gold, gemstones incl. tanzanite) requires broker/dealer licences issued under the Mining Act and Mineral Trading Regulations.
informed: REG-MINING flag on CAT-43 and gemstone jewellery; listing requires licence number + admin verification

SRC-TZ-ECON.title: Tanzania economic structure (agriculture weight)
SRC-TZ-ECON.researched: Agriculture is roughly a quarter of GDP and the largest employer; key crops maize, rice, cassava, beans, cashew, coffee, tea, cotton, tobacco, sisal, sesame, cloves.
informed: depth priority: agriculture/food/livestock branches get the deepest type coverage first

rules: Bei huhifadhiwa kwa TZS (integer, senti hazitumiki) + priceUnit (unitId) + optional pricePerBaseUnit iliyokokotolewa kwa vitengo convertible tu.
Stock huhifadhiwa kwa stockUnit moja kwa variant; mabadiliko kati ya vitengo hufanywa kwa conversion ya registry, kamwe kwa maandishi ya seller.
Vitengo vya PACKAGING/convertible=false vinahitaji contentQuantity + contentUnit ili kulinganisha bei (e.g. gunia 90 kg).
Kwa huduma: priceModel ∈ {fixed, per_hour, per_day, per_session, per_unit, quote}; unit inatoka TIME/SERVICE.

legacyMap.note: Registry: pair = piece 2. Stock ya zamani ilihesabu jozi; inabaki kwa jozi.
Bidhaa za zamani hazina ujazo wa chupa: NEEDS_REVIEW kabla ya kulinganisha bei kwa lita.
Lebo ya POS ni “Box (Katoni)”; content = pcsPerUnit pieces. Stock ya POS tayari iko kwa pieces.

apparel.note: Gender/age ni attribute ya leaf, si variant.

beauty.note: Expiry ni sifa ya batch (inventory lot), si variant.

forbidden: Origin+Organic combined with different price unit
food_fresh.note: Variants lazima ziwe na unitGroup moja (WEIGHT au COUNT, si zote mbili).

livestock.note: Mnyama hai mmoja = listing moja; variants kwa lots tu.

unique_assets.note: Kila gari/mali ni kipengee cha kipekee (VIN/plot no.) — hakuna variants.

parts.note: Fitment ni compatibility list, si variant.

arts_culture.note: Kazi ya kipekee (one-of-a-kind) haina variants; prints/replicas zinaruhusiwa.

services.note: Huduma hutumia "packages" badala ya stock; capacity = slots.

rules: Kila variant ina variantId thabiti, SKU ya kipekee ndani ya store, bei yake (au inarithi), stock yake kwa kila location, na hali (active/archived).
Variant axes lazima zitoke kwenye VARIANT_FAMILIES[family].axes; "Other (Specify)" value inaruhusiwa lakini huenda NEEDS_REVIEW.
Upeo: axes 3, combinations 100 kwa product (pendekezo la UX/perf).
Product.stock ni jumla iliyokokotolewa (derived) ya variants — haiandikwi na client (inashughulikia TX-H3).
